from pathlib import Path
import hashlib, json
root = Path('products/services/sqlite-repair')
paths = [root / 'launch/launch-baseline.json', root / 'launch/pre-cutoff-live-2026-11-21.html']
rows = []
for path in paths:
    row = {'path': str(path), 'present': path.is_file()}
    if row['present']:
        data = path.read_bytes()
        row.update(sha256=hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest(), bytes=len(data))
        if path.suffix == '.json':
            baseline = json.loads(data)
            row['baseline_keys'] = sorted(baseline) if isinstance(baseline, dict) else []
    rows.append(row)
result = {'scope': 'Pre-cutoff artifact inventory. A capture hash must be tied to a successful FETCH and publication receipt before identifying the live release. This is not a demand verdict.', 'cutoff_utc': '2026-11-22T00:00:00Z', 'artifacts': rows}
out = root / 'launch/pre-cutoff-evidence-inventory.json'
out.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
out.write_text(json.dumps(result, indent=2) + '\n', encoding='utf-8')
print(out.read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
